information.description:
Biotechnica's rewilding crews work where meat doesn't last: blighted soil, toxic runoff, forests that still glow on a scanner. The Demeter climbs, tastes the chemistry in the air and doesn't need to breathe it. The company calls it a gift to the planet, and bills the crews for it.

Cost: 14,600eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 44 ([1d6/2] + 13d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Chemical Analyzer, Chipware Socket, Grip Foot ×2, Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, Olfactory Boost, Radiation Detector, Radio Communicator, Self-ICE, Titanium Bones

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
